methods.title: Waiting for confirmation
paras: “20 × 16 × 8 × 2”, in the meeting notes, is waiting for confirmation from Joe. Read as: a 20 s cue pair × 16 trials a session × 8 rats × 2 sessions.

Coherence here comes from pooled spectra (every 1 s piece of every trial in a session in one cross-spectrum), not the mean of per-trial coherence as in Dickson et al. (2022). Mean over rats and pairs, cue pair: theta Precon1 pooled 0.121 against 0.163 as the mean of trials; theta Precon4 pooled 0.117 against 0.155 as the mean of trials; gamma Precon1 pooled 0.103 against 0.135 as the mean of trials; gamma Precon4 pooled 0.127 against 0.156 as the mean of trials.

methods.title: Data included
paras: 8 rats (J3, J4, J6, J7, J8, J9, J10, J11), analysed as one cohort with no between-subject factor. Two sessions: Precon1 (Early) and Precon4 (Late). Trials per session after the cue pairs were found: 12 to 16 (a trial is one cue pair, cue 1 then cue 2, each about 10 s).

Regions: retrosplenial cortex (RSC), dorsal hippocampus (dHC), anterior cingulate (ACC), orbitofrontal cortex (OFC) and perirhinal cortex (PER), each recorded on both sides; the postrhinal probes were not in postrhinal cortex and are not used. A side is used only where histology (v2, 2026-10-05) scored its probe “y”. Each side has 2 wires (PER 4); in each window of each trial the lowest-numbered wire that is not marked bad and not clipped is used (one wire a side).

Windows, aligned to the cue pulses (TTL events; the pairing of two different cue pulses 10 ± 0.25 s apart, TTL 126 the end of cue 2): the 10 s before cue 1 (baseline), cue 1 (onset to cue 2 onset), cue 2 (onset to its end), and the cue pair (cue 1 + cue 2, about 20 s). Full windows; the cue-onset response is part of what is measured.

Ten region pairs (RSC–dHC, RSC–ACC, RSC–OFC, RSC–PER, dHC–ACC, dHC–OFC, dHC–PER, ACC–OFC, ACC–PER, OFC–PER). Within a rat, a region pair's value is the mean of its valid wire pairs, ipsilateral (left–left, right–right) and contralateral (left–right, right–left) alike; homotopic pairs (one structure, left with right) are never used. A region's power is the mean of its valid sides, in dB. A pair or region enters a model only with at least 4 rats.

methods.title: Preprocessing
paras: Neuralynx recordings sampled at 32000 Hz, read in µV (ADBitVolts × 10⁶), decimated to 1 kHz (scipy.signal.decimate, an order-8 Chebyshev anti-aliasing filter run forwards and backwards). No re-referencing: signals as recorded against the acquisition reference.

Artifact rejection by clipping: a wire is excluded from a window when it sits within 0.5% of the digitiser's rail (ADMaxValue, ±2000 µV input range) for 16 or more consecutive samples, covering 0.5% of the window or one unbroken 50 ms; the next wire of that side is used, and if none is left the side is missing in that window. Wires marked bad by hand are excluded everywhere.
Line noise: a second-order Butterworth band-stop at 59–61 Hz (MATLAB designfilt, run with filtfilt, as Dickson et al.); the 59–61 Hz bins are left out of every gamma average.

methods.title: Spectral method
paras: Coherence (magnitude-squared): MATLAB mscohere's settings — a 1024-sample hanning window (MATLAB's, without zero end points), 512 samples of overlap and a 2048-point FFT at 1 kHz (0.49 Hz resolution) — with the cross- and auto-spectra summed over every piece of every trial of a session before the coherence is taken (pooled). Bands: theta 5–12 Hz; gamma 30–90 Hz without 59–61 Hz. Frequency bins: theta at the FFT's own 0.49 Hz; gamma in 2 Hz bins.

Power: the same pieces' one-sided power spectral density (µV²/Hz), the mean over every piece of a session's trials, a band's mean then 10·log10 (dB re 1 µV²/Hz). No normalisation per rat: the rat is the GEE's cluster, and Session × Period cancels drift between the days.

Oscillation against background: FOOOF 1.1 (specparam), 2–55 Hz, fixed aperiodic mode, peak widths 1–8 Hz, up to 6 peaks; the aperiodic exponent and offset, and the strongest peak centred in 5–12 Hz (its frequency and power above the background).

Granger causality: each signal at 250 Hz, 1 s pieces half overlapping, mean removed, MATLAB's hanning, a 500-point FFT; the 2 × 2 cross-spectral matrix pooled over every piece of a session's cue pairs; Wilson's spectral factorisation; spectral Granger (Geweke) both ways, its band mean; a pair the mean of its valid wire pairs.

Theta–gamma coupling: within one wire, 5–12 Hz phase and 30–90 Hz amplitude (zero-phase band-pass, Hilbert transform, mirrored padding), 18 phase bins, the amplitude summed by bin over every trial's cue pair, then Tort's modulation index; a region the mean of its sides.

methods.title: Statistical model
paras: Every test is a generalised estimating equation (statsmodels 0.15 GEE): the rat as the subject (cluster), an exchangeable working correlation. Coherence, Granger and the modulation index: Gamma distribution with a log link (effects are ratios). Power (dB) and the FOOOF parameters: normal distribution with the identity link (effects are differences).

Tests of up to 2 degrees of freedom use robust (sandwich) errors with Mancl and DeRouen's small-sample correction; tests of more (Pair, and any term with Frequency) cannot be estimated robustly from 8 clusters and use the model-based errors, which rest on the working correlation; those are reported but not relied on. Wald chi-square tests.

Coherence across sessions (each pair): Late vs Early on the band; Session × Frequency across bins. Phase 2 (each pair): Session × Cue (cue 1, cue 2; every Precon trial is a matched pairing, A→B or C→D, pooled). Coherence and power in the three periods (each pair; each region on its own, Region is never a factor): Session × Period (2 df), and the planned contrasts Session × (cue 1 vs baseline), Session × (cue 2 vs baseline), Session × (cue 2 vs cue 1), each on 1 df; power also Session × Period × Frequency. Granger (each pair and band that passed): Late vs Early in each direction and Session × Direction. Theta–gamma MI (each region of those pairs): Late vs Early.

Reference category: the tests do not depend on it (sum coding). Coefficients are reported as SPSS reports them, with the last level of each factor (in ascending order) the reference: Session, Precon4; Period, cue 2; Frequency, the highest bin (11.96 Hz in theta, 89 Hz in gamma); Direction, the second. The coefficient tables are in the exports.

Correction: Benjamini–Hochberg (FDR) across the ten pairs for each coherence test, across the five regions for each power and FOOOF test, and within each follow-up family (Granger, MI). The results are reported both corrected (q < 0.05) and uncorrected (p < 0.05); which pairs are followed up depends on which is used.

Robustness, beside every result that passes: the model refitted eight times, each without one rat (does p stay below 0.05 every time, and which rat does it lean on); and a linear mixed model with a random intercept for the rat (on the log for coherence, Granger and MI; on dB for power), a Wald F on k and k(n − 1) degrees of freedom, which is Kenward–Roger's for a within-rat effect in a balanced design.
